title: The Episode About the Origin of the Khalsa

blocks.text: Then a great military camp with four divisions was raised, extending over the plain between Delhi and Agra. (6)
The Marathas became anxious and entrusted the territory to Perron under military command. (7)
In the year seventeen hundred and ninety-eight, the Marathas lost that region and the English took control, plunging the Maratha house into grief. (8)
Then the British commander in Delhi — Lake Akhtar, the general — heard how the Singhs had surrounded Delhi and shaken British confidence. (9)
The English general became angry and asked: who had armed the Singhs, and which sovereign had granted them dominion? (10–11)
